name: Super Player
author: enrell
description: Media controls and synced lyrics for whatever is playing: the line being sung right now in the bar, and a popup with transport, volume, mute and the full lyrics.

barWidget.description: Shows the line being sung right now plus a progress hairline. Opens a popup with previous/play-pause/next, a volume slider, mute and the full synced lyrics, with optional romanization and translation.

schema.label: Player
options: any MPRIS player currently on the bus
schema.description: Which player to follow. Automatic follows whichever player is playing, and falls back to the first one available.

schema.label: Romanize
schema.description: Transliterate lyrics to Latin script: replace the original line, or show the romanized line under it. Uses pykakasi when installed (Japanese kanji readings), otherwise kakasi or ICU uconv (kana, Hangul, Cyrillic, Greek, ...).

schema.label: Translate to
schema.description: Translate the lyrics to this language (Google Translate). The translation appears under each line and, when available, in the bar label. Results are cached per track.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the bar shows: the current lyric line (translation, else romanization, else the original, falling back to the track title), the track title, or just the music note.

schema.label: Label width (px)
schema.description: Maximum width of the bar label before it starts scrolling.

schema.label: Hide when the track has no lyrics
schema.description: Hide the widget while the current track has no synced lyrics instead of showing the track title.
